facts.statement: Free Realms offered free ThunderCats-themed items as a promotion tied to the ThunderCats show on Cartoon Network.
facts.quote: Did you know that you can get FREE ThunderCats™ themed items in Free Realms ®?

facts.statement: Free Realms offered free ThunderCats-themed items for a limited time.
facts.quote: you can get FREE ThunderCats™ themed items in Free Realms

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post (captured September 2011) announcing free ThunderCats-themed items: a Poster, a T-shirt, and the Sword of Omens weapon. The items were obtained by watching ThunderCats show videos through the yellow ad box on the MY PROFILE page, and were offered for a limited time. The post is dated only relatively ('Posted 1 month, 1 week ago'), so no absolute date can be recovered.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades? (Check out the ThunderCats™ Items in Free Realms!)
article_summaries.summary: A promotional news post (page in Portuguese chrome, body in English) announcing free ThunderCats-themed items in Free Realms. Players obtained them by watching ThunderCats videos through the yellow ad box on the MY PROFILE page, and the items were available only for a limited time. The post gives no absolute date; it shows only a relative 'Publicado 2 meses, 2 dias atrás' stamp.
